text: I think you'll really enjoy this Twice-Baked Potato Casserole recipe, given your past preferences for recipes featuring high-calorie ingredients like cheese and bacon. The combination of cheddar cheese, sour cream, and milk will likely appeal to you, and the addition of green onion and crumbled bacon adds a nice depth of flavor. The recipe's rich, comforting nature might also remind you of your favorite stews. With a cooking time of about 65 minutes, it's a bit longer than your usual 35 minutes, but I think the payoff will be worth it.
